description_en: Retrieves the playback or download URL of a call recording based on the recording file name
description_zh: 通过本接口，可以根据录音文件名获取录音试听或下载地址
name: CloudGetRecordUrl

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The recording type. If you do not specify this parameter, the system parses the type from the RecordFile parameter. Valid values: record (recording), voicemail (voice mail), tsi (color ring back tone, returned when number recording status recognition is enabled, a preview outbound call is initiated, the customer number is a mobile phone number, and the customer does not answer the call), rasr (customer-side recording of the voice bot), transfer (call transfer), consult (consultation), and threeway (three-way call)
parameters.help_zh: 录音类型，不填可根据 recordFile 解析；record:录音voicemail:留言tsi:彩铃、当开启号码录音状态识别，发起预览外呼，客户号码是手机且客户未接听时返回该地址 rasr:语音机器人客户侧录音 transfer:转接consult:咨询threeway:三方
parameters.name: record_type

parameters.help_en: The format of the recording file. Valid values: 0 (MP3) and 1 (WAV). Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 录音文件类型；取值说明：0为mp3，1为wav，默认为mp3类型
parameters.name: record_format

parameters.help_en: The call type. This parameter is required to obtain the customer-side or agent-side recording when split-line recording is enabled. This parameter takes effect only when RecordFormat is set to 1 and is ignored when RecordFormat is set to 0. Valid values: 1 (inbound call), 2 (web call), 4 (preview outbound call), and 5 (predictive outbound call)
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫类型；说明：开启分线录音时，获取客户侧或座席侧录音需要，recordFormat=1时有效，recordFormat=0时忽略。取值范围：1,2,4,5（数字含义：呼入,webcall,预览外呼,预测外呼）
parameters.name: call_type

parameters.help_en: The recording side for split-line recording. This parameter is required to obtain the customer-side or agent-side recording when split-line recording is enabled. This parameter takes effect only when RecordFormat is set to 1 and is ignored when RecordFormat is set to 0. Valid values: 1 (customer side) and 2 (agent side). If RecordSide is not empty, CallType is required
parameters.help_zh: 分线录音侧；说明：开启分线录音时，获取客户侧或座席侧录音需要，recordFormat=1时有效，recordFormat=0时忽略。取值范围：1,2 (数字含义：客户侧，座席侧)recordSide不为空时，callType必选
parameters.name: record_side

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to download the recording. A value of 1 indicates download. A value of 0 or an empty value indicates playback
parameters.help_zh: 是否下载；１为下载，空或０表示试听
parameters.name: download

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of OK indicates that the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 状态码。返回OK代表请求成功

Url.description_en: The playback or download URL. By default, the URL expires after 120 minutes. You can configure the expiration time. After the URL expires, you must call the API operation again to obtain a new URL
Url.description_zh: 试听或下载地址，默认120分钟过期（可配置），过期后，需重新请求接口
Url.title_en: 试听或下载地址，默认120分钟过期（可配置），过期后，需重新请求接口
Url.title_zh: 试听或下载地址，默认120分钟过期（可配置），过期后，需重新请求接口
